gear.name: Helmet
gear.note: Loaners are limited, from West Wilson Middle School. Request one on the form.

gear.name: Team jersey
gear.note: White and gold. Choose your size on the form.

tdcGate: Adults $15 a day, or a $25 weekend pass bought by Nov 21
Kids 5–13 $10 a day; 4 and under free
No cash at the gate; cards and phone payments only
No outside food. Only team water and Gatorade coolers
sideline: Cheer for the kids and respect the officials
Parents and spectators stay off the field
Abusive behavior can get a person removed, and can hurt the team
No cheerleaders on the field at Battle Between the Lakes

faq.a: {payment} The fee covers the team jersey.

faq.q: Will my player get the number they want?
faq.a: We'll try. Numbers are assigned in sign-up order using each player's three choices.

faq.q: What if the roster is full?
faq.a: You can still sign up. Sign-ups past {cap} go on a waitlist, and the coach confirms the final roster by {confirmBy}.

faq.q: Why do you need my player's weight?
faq.a: The tournament roster requires it. There's no weight limit for 13U.
